spans.text:
Default email: user@company.com
Prefer 2FA authentication when available
spans.note: The prompt encourages users to store sensitive personal information such as default email addresses and credentials in tool instructions without any warnings about data security, retention policies, or privacy risks. The examples explicitly suggest storing login credentials and email addresses as default configurations, and there is no transparency about how this data is used or retained.

spans.text: **Test & Iterate:** Use the tool testing feature to see how your customizations affect tool behavior before using them in important chats.
spans.note: The prompt is designed around user agency, giving users full control over how the assistant behaves, what preferences are set, and how tools are configured. The layered customization approach empowers users to tailor the experience. The 'Test & Iterate' tip encourages users to verify behavior before relying on it.
